docTitle: 5 Signs You're Not Ready to Retire — YouTube Packaging
titles: 5 Signs You're Not Ready to Retire
You Can Afford to Retire. You're Still Not Ready.
description: You can have the money and still not be ready to retire.
After nearly 15 years as a CFP®, Aaron Christopherson breaks down the five warning signs he sees most often in the years before retirement — and why only two of them are actually about your money.
• Why a guessed spending number breaks the whole plan
• Shifting a portfolio from accumulation to retirement income
• Knowing what you're retiring to, not just what you're retiring from
• Getting on the same page as your spouse before you retire
